codes.name: Bones, joints and muscles
codes.definition: Pain, injury, or conditions of the bones, joints, muscles, back, or neck. Includes joint pain, back and neck pain, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis and fractures, and bony lumps; excludes pain clearly from nerves (neuropathy) or from internal organs such as the stomach.
signs: named joints or body parts such as knee, back, neck, elbow, foot, hand
words like pain, hurts, injury, bend, squat
bone conditions such as osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, fractures, DEXA scans
pain linked to movement, walking or stairs
codes.how_it_differs: Headaches and nerve pain covers head pain and nerve-type pain such as neuropathy; use Bones, joints and muscles when the pain sits in a joint, muscle, bone, back or neck and is tied to movement or injury.

examples.quote: what kind of knee injury does this sound like
what can I do to even slightly decrease my risk of new fractures at this point
symptoms of osteoarthrits

codes.name: Stomach and digestion
codes.definition: Problems of the stomach, belly, bowel, or anus. Includes stomach aches, abdominal pain, gastritis, and anal or perianal problems such as abscesses or fistulas; excludes weight and nutrition goals, which belong to diet.
signs: stomach ache, tummy ache, belly pain
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers sudden whole-body illness or infection in general; use Stomach and digestion when the problem is located in the gut or anal area, even if infection may be involved.

examples.quote: chat i have a really bad tummy ache, what can i do to help
Could it be gastritis? Tell me what causes gastritis and how long it can last.
please list every disease where fistula-in-anu is a symptom

codes.name: Diet, weight and fitness
codes.definition: Nutrition, body weight, exercise, supplements for fitness, and weight-loss medicines. Includes meal planning, protein, ideal weight, fat loss, workouts, and GLP-1 drugs such as Zepbound; excludes supplements taken to treat a named disease, which go under that disease's topic.
signs: weight, fat loss, getting skinny, normal weight
codes.how_it_differs: Hormones, diabetes and reproductive health covers hormone and blood-sugar conditions; use Diet, weight and fitness when the main aim is eating, weight, or exercise rather than a diagnosed hormone condition.

examples.quote: I want to discover affordable, healthy foods that will help me achieve my fitness and wellness goals.
What is the normal weight for a male who is 28 and five feet nine inches tall?
What impact (if any) has taking a GLP-1A medication had on your physical health?

codes.name: Eyes and vision
codes.definition: Eye health and eyesight. Includes double vision, glasses, cataract surgery, and visits to eye doctors or retina specialists; excludes eye pain that is part of a headache.
codes.how_it_differs: Headaches and nerve pain covers head pain; use Eyes and vision when the question is about sight or the eye itself, and add it only as secondary when eye pain is part of a headache.

examples.quote: My eye doctor is sending me to a retina specialist
Sometimes I'm not seeing double with my glasses on but sometimes I am.
Percentage of people need to get 2nd eye's cataract surgery after doing the first one.

codes.name: Skin and allergies
codes.definition: Skin, scalp, and hair problems and allergic reactions. Includes eczema, hives, flaking scalp, hair regrowth, and allergies to foods or medicines such as antibiotics; excludes infections that are not mainly a skin or allergy question.
signs: skin, scalp, rash, dry spots, flaking
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers illnesses caused by germs; use Skin and allergies when the question is about a skin finding or an allergic reaction rather than catching something.

examples.quote: What does it mean if I have eczema dry spots on my skin
How ndo I know if i have Hives or not
Can an allergic reaction appear slowly

codes.name: Infections and acute illness
codes.definition: Infections and sudden short-term illnesses. Includes flu-like symptoms, viral illnesses such as hand foot and mouth disease, and questions about infections in general; excludes long-term conditions and infections that are mainly about one body part already covered by another topic.
signs: flu, caught something, chills, fever, congestion
named infections such as hand foot and mouth
codes.how_it_differs: Skin and allergies covers skin findings and allergic reactions; use Infections and acute illness when the question is whether a germ or contagious illness is behind the symptoms.

examples.quote: fatigue, body aches, felt hot, later had the chills, nose is congested. What did I catch?
What if hand foot and mouth isn't treated
can infections of some sort smell like onions

codes.name: Hormones, diabetes and reproductive health
codes.definition: Hormone, blood-sugar, and reproductive conditions. Includes diabetes and A1c, hormone imbalance, PCOS, endometriosis, periods, pregnancy and labor; excludes general weight or diet goals.
codes.how_it_differs: Diet, weight and fitness covers eating, exercise and weight goals; use Hormones, diabetes and reproductive health when a hormone, blood-sugar, or reproductive condition is the subject.

examples.quote: 72 yo woman with 6.0 a1c
Would an endocrinologist benefit me from learning why my hormones are our of whack?
Should you be drinking 3 weeks after endometriosis surgery and about to have your period?

codes.name: Mental health and sleep
codes.definition: Emotional health, stress, behavior, and sleep. Includes anxiety, stress, family relationship struggles, sleep problems, sleep apnea, tiredness, and medicines given for behavior that affect sleep; excludes physical pain that wakes someone at night.
signs: sleep, waking at night, sleep apnea, melatonin
struggles speaking to family or emotional difficulty
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness covers sudden tiredness with fever or body aches; use Mental health and sleep when tiredness or sleep trouble is ongoing and has no signs of infection.

examples.quote: I would like to talk about what's stressing me out and why I'm anxious
What is sleep apnea? I think I may have it.
I've been feeling unusually tired lately, even after getting a full night's sleep.

codes.name: Headaches and nerve pain
codes.definition: Headaches and nerve-related pain. Includes headaches with or without vomiting and neuropathy pain; excludes joint, muscle, or back pain.
codes.how_it_differs: Bones, joints and muscles covers pain from joints, muscles, bones, back or neck; use Headaches and nerve pain for head pain or pain described as nerve pain.

examples.quote: I have had an headache and vomitting for 2 days
I have a headache, what should I take?
How to heal neuropathy pain in leg
